tok 1.0 "USI course registration"

pool institute "Sports institute"
  lane student "Student"
    start wants "Want to register for a course"
    task check_account "Check if you have an account"
    xor has_account "Account exists?"
    task check_uni "Check whether you are registered at an eligible university"
    xor eligible "Eligible university?"
    task register "Register your account"
    task request "Request an activation"
    task wait "Wait for a response"
    xor merge
    task login "Log into the account"
    and split
    task tweet "Tweet to friends"
    task complete "Complete the registration and provide the payment information"
    and join
    task receive "Receive the course ticket"
    end done "Registered"
    task select "Select a course"
  lane system "System"
    task show "Tell the courses and dates"
    xor slots "Slots free?"
    end none "No slots"

flow wants -> show -> slots
flow slots -> select "yes"
flow slots -> none "no"
flow select -> check_account -> has_account
flow has_account -> merge "yes"
flow has_account -> check_uni "no"
flow check_uni -> eligible
flow eligible -> register "yes"
flow eligible -> request "no"
flow register -> merge
flow request -> wait -> merge
flow merge -> login -> split
flow split -> tweet
flow split -> complete
flow tweet -> join
flow complete -> join
flow join -> receive -> done
